nodes.detail: Interleaved classical spatial-temporal feature extraction with quantum data re-uploading circuits for multichannel pediatric EEG classification and exact analytical gradient interpretability.; Observed: The work provides the first end-to-end benchmark of quantum data re-uploading on a full clinical 120-subject EEG cohort with rigorous non-inferiority comparisons against established deep neural baselines (EEGNet, ADHDeepNet), analytical barren plateau profiling, and electrophysiologically validated gradient topomaps.
nodes.label: novelty: justified
nodes.observed: The work provides the first end-to-end benchmark of quantum data re-uploading on a full clinical 120-subject EEG cohort with rigorous non-inferiority comparisons against established deep neural baselines (EEGNet, ADHDeepNet), analytical barren plateau profiling, and electrophysiologically validated gradient topomaps.

nodes.detail: This work introduced the hybrid quantum-classical data re-uploading network (Hybrid DRU), a classifier for electroencephalography (EEG) screening of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD). It contributed two components: Circular Data Re-Uploading (CDRU), which re-uploads four convolutional features with unit-scale encoding into a ring-entangled circuit so that depth alone fixes its accessible frequencies, and Analytical Saliency via Parameter-Shift Backpropagation, which carries the exact derivative of every qubit expectation through the convolutional front-end to each electrode. Unlike post-hoc attribution methods, the proposed Hybrid DRU takes its channel attributions from the exact gradients of the trained model, without surrogate models or input perturbation, and its expressivity is known before training rather than measured after it.
nodes.label: This work introduced the hybrid quantum-classical data re-uploading network (Hybrid DRU), a classifier for electroencephalography (EEG) screening of Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD).

nodes.detail: On the general task, the Hybrid DRU matched but did not surpass its comparators. Evaluated subject-wise on 120 children, its balanced accuracy was statistically indistinguishable from those of the single-upload and linear readouts and of EEGNet, and non-inferiority to EEGNet could not be established. A recording-duration control came close to every network, leaving an EEG classifier only a small margin to claim on this cohort. The model operated at a higher sensitivity than EEGNet at the cost of specificity, without a better ranking of the children. Circular Data Re-Uploading delivered the expressivity it promises where that expressivity is known to matter. On synthetic EEG whose class depends on the second harmonic of one feature, three uploads outperformed a single upload in every paired replicate, while the parameterization stayed close to that of EEGNet and far below that of ADHDeepNet. On the clinical cohort, neither re-uploading, nor the entangling ring, nor additional depth improved accuracy, and gradient variance decreased only slightly across depth, without the collapse of a barren plateau. The capacity CDRU adds is therefore verified but is not what limits accuracy on these data. The analytical saliency localized the decisions of the model on the frontal scalp. The saliency energy of the fronto-central electrodes exceeded that of the temporal-occipital ones in every child with ADHD, in both the Theta and the Beta band, with its maximum at a left-frontal electrode. The learned features did not correlate with the Theta/Beta biomarkers reported for ADHD, and no faithfulness measure was computed, so this localization describes where the trained model is sensitive rather than which electrodes cause its decisions.
nodes.label: On the general task, the Hybrid DRU matched but did not surpass its comparators.

nodes.detail: For clinicians and reviewers, the consequence is a screening model whose sensitivity can be traced to electrodes and whose reported performance is a property of unseen children rather than of recordings the model has already seen. Accuracies reported on this cohort from epoch-level rather than subject-level splits, or without a check of what recording duration alone predicts, should be read with caution.
nodes.label: For clinicians and reviewers, the consequence is a screening model whose sensitivity can be traced to electrodes and whose reported performance is a property of unseen children rather than of recordings the model has already seen.

nodes.detail: Future work follows three directions motivated by the limitations of this study. First, deeper re-uploading circuits will be trained with local cost functions, which keep gradients measurable in parameterized circuits , to relax the depth bound of the present model. Second, the circuit will be executed on physical quantum processors, estimating the parameter-shift gradients behind the saliency maps from finite measurement shots , to test whether the attributions survive hardware noise. Third, the model will be validated on independent multi-center cohorts with different montages and acquisition protocols, following the external-validation practice recommended for clinical machine learning . Together, these directions would carry the method from a simulated single-cohort study towards clinical screening.
nodes.label: Future work follows three directions motivated by the limitations of this study.
